ModMetaData.name: Walk the World
ModMetaData.author: addvans
ModMetaData.description:
Explore every inch of the planet. Walk drafted pawns to a map edge to move into the neighboring world tile, explore landmarks and temporary sites, visit settlements, trade, steal, fight, and roam the world in a more open RPG style.
Exploration maps are temporary and may regenerate after leaving unless pawns or player-owned structures keep the map loaded.
